title: Intent Check DeepScan API, contract v1
description: The body of POST /deepscans: a gzip'd JSON snapshot of the repo. Shared by the intent plugin and the prover. Changes are additive only.

RepoPath.description: Relative, forward-slash path inside the repo: no leading slash, no drive letter, no backslash, no empty or '..' segments, no NUL.

reason.description: Why the plugin left the file out (e.g. over_cap, too_large, binary, vendored, generated, secret).

remote_url.description: Normalized to https with userinfo stripped, or null when the repo has no remote.

head_sha.description: Null for a repo without commits.

dirty.description: True when the working tree differs from HEAD.

scope.description: Path prefix the scan was limited to, or null for the whole repo.

file_count.description: Files in `files`. The server recomputes it.

bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes of all `content`. The server recomputes it.

trimmed.description: Files left out of the snapshot, listed in the report's coverage section.

content.description: Redacted UTF-8 text, at most 512 KB, no NUL characters. Line numbers are preserved.

DeepscanUpload.description: The document inside the gzip body of POST /deepscans (content-type application/gzip, at most 16 MB compressed and 20 MB inflated). At most 3000 files and 15 MB of text; paths are unique.

DeepscanDepth.description: How deep the scan goes: fast hunts each property once (about 15-20 minutes), balanced has both models hunt every property (about 30-35 minutes), full adds a second attack on every property that held (about 40-45 minutes). A missing depth means balanced.
